The spot is now at the 13th percentile of its 24h range and 2nd percentile of its 7d range — the consolidation is not holding above entry. With only 62h remaining before expiry and the position at -0.48% against a -1.5% stop, the thesis of a P/C-driven bounce has not materialized. The btc_spot trajectory shows a consistent drift lower over the last 12 snapshots (77,010 → 76,618) with no reversal signal. Closing to preserve capital before the stop is hit.
